about: Three live test deals on Sepolia, one per ending, shown under the demo's player (T-427; since T-500 one security-review deal of the kind Crow's first pilot runs, in review.ts). Run with tools/duet/review-deals.ts: a seller Crow ran for the page, with a fresh key, sold the demo review to Crow's test buyer. Taken from each deal's public record on the live API: offeredAt and endedAt are the record's commitment.offered and settlement event times; tx is the settlement event's transaction. A refresh is a change of this file and one publish.

endings.title: The work passes
endings.rule: The seller is paid, and the buyer gets the key to the report in the same step.
endings.measure: from the seller's offer to the payment
endings.how: The report passed all five checks, so the checks alone decided and no AI judge was needed. The buyer paid 41 test dollars in all: the price and the reviewer's fee of 1 test dollar.

endings.title: The work fails
endings.rule: The price goes back to the buyer, and the report stays locked.
endings.measure: from the seller's offer to the refund
endings.how: The same terms as the deal that passed. This report left out the proof of concept for its first Critical finding, so the proof check failed; the other four passed. The reviewer kept its fee of 1 test dollar.

endings.title: The seller goes silent
endings.rule: Nothing arrived by the deadline, so the whole payment went back to the buyer, without the buyer asking.
endings.measure: from the seller's offer to the refund

amount.label: back to the buyer: the price and the reviewer's fee

endings.how: The seller took the deal and never delivered. The terms gave it 5 minutes from the offer; the payment went back 21 seconds after that deadline.
